podcast.title: Co-founder of Kefta Boyz
podcast.body: Khaled co-founded the influential collective Kefta Boyz in Granada, which was doing something radically new in the country, inspired by American trap and Memphis rap. "La banda formada en granada por John Biff, Calet, Wormini entre muchos otros, hacía algo radicalmente nuevo en el país."

srcs.episode: La salvaje historia del TRAP ESPAÑOL (2013-2026)

podcast.title: Co-founder of PXXR GANG
podcast.body: Khaled, along with John Biff, K.D.K.in, and Steve Lean, founded PXXR GANG in El Raval, a band that would change the Spanish music scene. "fundan la banda que lo cambiará todo, la pur gang."

srcs.episode: La salvaje historia del TRAP ESPAÑOL (2013-2026)

podcast.title: Move to El Raval
podcast.body: After Kefta Boyz and Los Corredores del Bloque made good friends, Khaled and John Biff moved from Granada to El Raval in Barcelona. This move was crucial for the formation of PXXR GANG. "John Biff y Calet no vuelven a granada."
